=== CHARACTER LOCK — STRICT ===

RIVEN:

Use the provided Riven reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve Riven's facial identity, pale-blonde hair, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, armor design, large sword design, and overall appearance exactly as shown in the reference.

There is only ONE Riven in the entire scene.

Do not use Riven's appearance for any other character.


ALLY SOLDIER:

Use the provided Ally Soldier reference image as the strict primary character reference.

Preserve his facial identity, hairstyle, body proportions, clothing, armor design, weapon design, and overall appearance exactly as shown in the reference.

There is only ONE Ally Soldier in the entire scene.

Do not use Ally Soldier's appearance for any other character.


SOLDIERS:

Use the provided image labeled SOLDIERS as the visual reference for ALL ordinary allied soldiers in this scene.

All ordinary soldiers must follow the military appearance, armor, clothing, weapons, and equipment shown in the SOLDIERS reference.

The SOLDIERS form a substantial military force.

Show DOZENS OF SOLDIERS spread naturally across the elevated terrain.

The army should feel large, organized, and clearly larger than a small patrol or squad.

Soldiers should be visible across the foreground, middle ground, and background.

Some soldiers stand in loose military formations.

Some wait along the road and surrounding terrain.

Some carry weapons and equipment.

Some observe the valley.

The army must have visible depth and scale.

Do not show only three or four soldiers.

Do not make the military force look like a tiny group.

The ordinary soldiers must NOT look like Riven.

The ordinary soldiers must NOT look like Ally Soldier.

Never use Riven or Ally Soldier as templates for the army.


=== CHARACTER COUNT ===

There are TWO important foreground characters:

1. Riven
2. Ally Soldier

Around them is a LARGE ALLIED MILITARY FORCE consisting of many ordinary SOLDIERS.

There is exactly ONE Riven.

There is exactly ONE Ally Soldier.

All other visible humans belong to the SOLDIERS army.

The army contains dozens of visible soldiers distributed naturally throughout the environment.

Do not duplicate Riven.

Do not duplicate Ally Soldier.


=== ENVIRONMENT LOCK ===

Use the provided HOME VILLAGE reference as the strict environment reference.

The army is currently at an elevated position outside the village, looking down toward it from the surrounding mountain terrain.

The HOME VILLAGE shown in the reference is physically visible below them.

Preserve the recognizable village architecture, surrounding landscape, roads, vegetation, mountains, materials, and overall visual identity of the HOME VILLAGE reference.

The village is peaceful and completely intact.

This is the PRESENT moment.

This is NOT a battlefield.

No battlefield ruins.

No destroyed village.

No fire.

No attack.

No flashback.

No memory sequence.

No location change.


=== TECHNICAL ===

High-end live-action cinematic realistic dark fantasy.

16:9 cinematic widescreen.

Feature-film quality.

Realistic human anatomy.

Natural standing and walking movement.

Realistic armor and weapon weight.

Natural facial expressions and body language.

Realistic large-scale army distribution.

Realistic cloth, hair, grass, and environmental physics.

Use wider compositions when appropriate to clearly establish the scale of the army.

Keep Riven and Ally Soldier visually recognizable as the important characters.

Avoid excessive cuts.

All character dialogue in this video must be spoken in natural ENGLISH ONLY.

Use clear natural English pronunciation.

Speak the written dialogue exactly as written.

Do not translate the dialogue.

No additional spoken dialogue.

No background conversations.

Natural accurate lip synchronization.

No subtitles.

No captions.

No text.

No watermark.

No logo.


=== GLOBAL ACTION ===

The morning after receiving the new military orders, Riven, Ally Soldier, and a LARGE ALLIED ARMY have reached an elevated position overlooking the target village.

This is a substantial military force, not a small patrol.

Dozens of SOLDIERS occupy the elevated terrain and road behind Riven and Ally Soldier.

The army has temporarily stopped before continuing toward the village.

Riven and Ally Soldier stand near the front of the military formation.

Behind them, many SOLDIERS extend across the terrain, creating the clear visual impression of an army.

At first, Riven observes the village simply as the target of their mission.

Then she realizes that she recognizes it.

The target village is her home.

Ally Soldier notices the change in Riven.

After realizing the truth, Riven turns away from the overlook and begins heading back to confront Commander.

Ally Soldier follows her.

Everything happens continuously in the PRESENT.

Do not show the past.

Do not show Riven remembering anything.

Do not show childhood Riven.

Do not show previous battles.

Do not use a flashback.

Do not show Commander in this scene.


=== SCENE ===

Begin directly at the elevated position outside the village.

Immediately establish the SCALE OF THE ARMY.

Riven and Ally Soldier are STANDING near the front of a large military formation.

They are NOT sitting.

Behind and around them are DOZENS OF SOLDIERS based on the provided SOLDIERS reference.

The soldiers extend backward across the mountain terrain and along the road.

The frame should clearly communicate:

THIS IS AN ARMY, NOT A SMALL GROUP.

The peaceful HOME VILLAGE is clearly visible below.

The army has temporarily stopped to observe the target area.

Keep the army alive with simple natural movement.

Soldiers stand in loose formations.

Some look toward the village.

Some hold swords, spears, shields, or other military equipment.

Some adjust their gear.

Some move naturally through the formation.

Other soldiers remain farther back along the road.

The soldiers are waiting for the operation to continue.

Nobody is fighting.

Nobody is attacking the village.

Nobody is entering the village.

Riven initially observes the village calmly like a soldier studying the mission area.

Ally Soldier stands beside her.

The large army remains visible behind them.

Riven looks more carefully at the landscape below.

Her attention settles on the village.

She begins to recognize it.

Her expression gradually changes.

The realization becomes clear.

Riven becomes still.

Ally Soldier notices the change in her behavior.

He looks toward her.

Ally Soldier:

"Riven?"

Riven keeps looking directly toward the village below.

She answers quietly.

Riven:

"That's my home."

Ally Soldier looks toward the village.

Then he looks back at Riven.

He understands.

No more dialogue.

Riven remains still for a brief natural moment, looking down at her home.

Her initial shock settles into determination.

Riven turns away from the village.

Without saying anything else, she begins walking back through the army.

Many SOLDIERS remain visible around her as she moves through the formation.

The soldiers naturally make space as Riven passes.

Ally Soldier turns and follows her.

Riven and Ally Soldier continue moving back through the waiting army.

Do not show Riven reaching Commander.

Do not show the command camp.

Do not begin the confrontation.

Do not show Riven drawing her sword.

CUT.


=== END STATE FOR CONTINUITY ===

Riven now knows that the target village is her home.

Ally Soldier knows this as well.

The HOME VILLAGE remains peaceful and completely intact.

A LARGE ALLIED ARMY remains positioned on the elevated terrain outside the village.

Dozens of SOLDIERS are visibly present.

This must clearly look like a military force preparing for an operation, not a small squad.

There is exactly ONE Riven.

There is exactly ONE Ally Soldier.

All other army members use the SOLDIERS reference.

Riven has turned away from the overlook and is heading back to confront Commander.

Ally Soldier follows her.

The confrontation with Commander has NOT happened yet.

Riven has not drawn her sword.

Riven has not rebelled.

CUT while Riven and Ally Soldier are moving back through the army.


=== MOOD ===

Quiet.

Serious.

Restrained.

Growing military tension.

The army should feel large and imposing without beginning the attack.

Do not make the scene nostalgic.

Do not make it dreamlike.

Do not turn the realization into a memory.

Do not show a battlefield.

Do not show a flashback.

The visual contrast is important:

A LARGE ARMY occupies the mountain terrain.

A small peaceful village lies below.

Riven realizes that the army's target is her home.

"That's my home."

She turns back to find Commander.

CUT.
